desc:
🎁 CODE: DRIVE25K for bonus cash! (Menu > Rewards > Codes)

🚗 Drive, race and roleplay in a huge open city! Buy your dream car, tune it, work jobs and race your friends.
⭐ New? The quick tutorial gets you your first car.

🏁 WHAT YOU CAN DO
🏆 Race Playlists: race chapters on 5 tracks with AI rivals and prize cars
🚘 Dealership: test drive and buy dozens of cars
🔧 Customization Shop: paint, rims, body kits, turbos and a dyno
🏎️ City street races with cinematic starts and a ghost of your best lap
🎉 Live events: car meets, speed traps and race rushes
💨 Stunts: speed traps, speed zones, time trials and drift zones
💼 Jobs: Taxi, Car Delivery and Mechanic shifts
👥 Crews, parties and leaderboards
🗺️ GPS, a full city map and rewards for exploring
⛽ Fuel, EV charging, day and night
🎁 Daily rewards, weekly goals and a Season Pass

Thanks for playing! New updates every week.
